name: Chef’s Salad
body:
Station and Complexity garde manger 3, line cook 3

Flavor Profiles umami, umami, salty
Additional Ingredients bitter, sour, spicy, sweet, texture, or umami

EFFECT

Duration 10 minutes/level; Serving Size 1

DESCRIPTION

A chef’s salad is a bed of greens on which is placed different proteins (ham, turkey, eggs, bacon) and other vegetables with a dressing of choice.

When consumed, a bound protein salad grants a greater magic aura, as the spell, for the duration.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1.

Additional bitter, sour, and spicy ingredients also grant a detect animals or plants effect, as the spell, for the duration.

Additional sweet ingredients also grant a greater detect magic effect, as the spell, for the duration.

Additional texture and umami ingredients also grant a detect undead effect, as the spell, for the duration.
